purpose: Teach: 特製/作風/家系/ごっこ/島国/走り出し/七つ/遠回り

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 店の特製パスタ、評判だよね。
lines.en: Their special pasta really does have a great reputation.
lines.style: Warm and genuine interest, leaning forward slightly. Open tone, natural pacing. Eyes bright with the pleasure of noticing something good.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。シェフの作風、独創的でね。
lines.en: Yeah. The chef's style is pretty original.
lines.style: Genuine agreement, a small smile in the voice. Relaxed but present — the ease of talking to someone she likes. Conversational pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 実は、料理人の家系なんだって。
lines.en: Apparently they come from a line of chefs.
lines.style: Curious, thoughtful pause after the dash. Gentle exploration of the fact, like sharing something you've just learned. Soft, genuine wonder.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お店ごっこ、子供の頃、よくやったね。
lines.en: We used to play shop so much as kids, remember?
lines.style: Nostalgic half-smile in the voice. Slower, warmer tempo. The kind of remembering that's both tender and slightly aching. Brief trailing fadeout.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 日本、島国だから、新鮮な魚、自慢だよね。
lines.en: Japan being an island country — I guess fresh fish is something to be proud of.
lines.style: Reflective, almost thinking aloud. Measured pace, gentle observation. The tone of someone connecting small dots. Slight breath between the two clauses.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 夕食の準備、走り出した、もう急がなきゃ。
lines.en: I should get going — dinner prep's already started and I'm running late.
lines.style: Lighter tone with underlying awareness of time pressing. Quick uptick in energy and pace, but not anxious. Practical, with a hint of good-natured resignation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 兄弟、七つも年上、頼もしいよね。
lines.en: Your brother's seven years older — he's always been someone you could really rely on.
lines.style: Soft, steady delivery. Genuine respect underlying the observation. Slow, even pace. The comfort of acknowledging something solid and true about someone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 帰り、遠回りして、夜景、見てきた。
lines.en: On the way home I took the long way around to catch the night view.
lines.style: Quiet, slightly dreamy quality. Slower pace, as if savoring the memory. Soft at the edges — the tenderness of doing something small for yourself. Gentle fadeout.
